queries.name: basis
queries.description: 我在什么运行、什么完成步上决策？自己的观测是否可用？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (run:Run {id: $run_id})
WITH run, coalesce($at_tick, run.latest_step) AS t
OPTIONAL MATCH (step:Step {run_id: $run_id, tick: t})
WITH run, t, collect(step) AS steps
CALL {
  WITH run
  OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:USES_DATASET]->(dataset:Dataset)
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT dataset{.id, .start, .time_unit, .warehouse_id}) AS datasets
}
CALL {
  WITH run, t
  OPTIONAL MATCH (robot:Robot {id: $run_id + ':robot:' + toString($robot_id), run_id: $run_id})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (exact:AgentState {id:robot.id+':state:'+toString(t),
                                    run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id, tick:t})
  CALL {
    WITH robot, exact, t
    WITH robot, t WHERE exact IS NULL
    OPTIONAL MATCH (previous:AgentState {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id})
    WHERE previous.tick <= t
    WITH previous ORDER BY previous.tick DESC, previous.id DESC LIMIT 1
    RETURN head(collect(previous)) AS fallback
  }
  WITH robot, coalesce(exact, fallback) AS state
  RETURN robot.type AS robot_type,
         state{.tick, .stage, .battery, .x, .y, .task_id, .cargo_id} AS self_state
}
RETURN run.id AS run_id, t, run.latest_step AS published_tick,
       size(steps) AS step_count,
       CASE WHEN size(steps) = 1 THEN properties(steps[0]) ELSE null END AS step,
       datasets, run.dataset_id AS declared_dataset_id, robot_type, self_state,
       t - self_state.tick AS state_age_ticks,
       run.config_json AS config_json,
       run.scene_sha256 AS scene_sha256, run.tasks_sha256 AS tasks_sha256,
       CASE WHEN size(steps) = 1 AND steps[0].complete = true
                 AND steps[0].received_robot_count >= steps[0].expected_robot_count
                 AND steps[0].expected_robot_count > 0
                 AND t <= run.latest_step
                 AND robot_type IS NOT NULL
                 AND self_state IS NOT NULL AND t - self_state.tick <= $max_state_age_ticks
            THEN true ELSE false END AS observation_ready

queries.name: task_pool
queries.description: 我空闲时，有哪些已释放的任务值得进一步评估？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id: $run_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (snapshot:DispatchState {run_id: $run_id})
WHERE snapshot.tick <= $t
WITH snapshot ORDER BY snapshot.tick DESC, snapshot.commit_seq DESC LIMIT 1
RETURN snapshot IS NOT NULL AS has_snapshot,
       snapshot.tick AS observed_tick, $t - snapshot.tick AS age_ticks,
       CASE WHEN snapshot IS NOT NULL AND $t - snapshot.tick <= $max_snapshot_age_ticks
            THEN true ELSE false END AS snapshot_fresh,
       snapshot.elapsed AS snapshot_elapsed,
       snapshot.pending_json AS pending_json,
       snapshot.active_jobs_json AS active_jobs_json,
       snapshot.tasks_json AS tasks_json,
       snapshot.ports_json AS ports_json,
       'bounded_queue_total_unknown' AS completeness

queries.name: task_geometry
queries.description: 这个任务到哪里取、到哪里放？我的机械臂能完成剩余操作吗？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
UNWIND $task_ids AS requested_task_id
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (:Execution {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
                 -[:EXECUTES]->(linked:WarehouseTask {task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH requested_task_id, collect(DISTINCT linked) AS linked_tasks
  OPTIONAL MATCH (scoped:WarehouseTask {dataset_id:$dataset_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH linked_tasks, collect(DISTINCT scoped) AS scoped_tasks
  RETURN CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN linked_tasks[0]
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 0 AND size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN scoped_tasks[0]
              ELSE null END AS task,
         CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_execution_link'
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_execution_links'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_dataset_namespace'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_static_definitions'
              ELSE 'not_observed' END AS task_resolution
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (task)-[:CONCERNS]->(goods:Goods)
OPTIONAL MATCH (task)-[:FROM]->(source:Location)
OPTIONAL MATCH (task)-[:TO]->(target:Location)
CALL {
  WITH task, source, target
  OPTIONAL MATCH (dataset:Dataset {id:task.dataset_id})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (dataset)-[:USES_LAYOUT]->(layout:Warehouse)
  WITH source, target, dataset, collect(DISTINCT layout) AS layouts
  OPTIONAL MATCH (direct:Warehouse)
  WHERE direct.id = source.warehouse_id OR direct.id = target.warehouse_id
  WITH dataset, layouts, collect(DISTINCT direct) AS direct_layouts
  RETURN dataset.start AS dataset_start,
    CASE WHEN size(direct_layouts) = 1 THEN direct_layouts[0]
         WHEN size(direct_layouts) = 0 AND size(layouts) = 1 THEN layouts[0]
         ELSE null END AS warehouse
}
CALL {
  WITH warehouse
  OPTIONAL MATCH (warehouse)-[:HAS_LOCATION]->(port:Location)
  WHERE port.kind IN ['inbound', 'outbound']
  RETURN collect(port{.location_id, .kind, .x, .y}) AS physical_ports
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (warehouse)-[:HAS_RACK]->(source_rack:Rack)-[:HAS_SLOT]->(source)
OPTIONAL MATCH (warehouse)-[:HAS_RACK]->(target_rack:Rack)-[:HAS_SLOT]->(target)
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id, type:'boundary_port_bound'})
  WHERE event.tick <= $t
  WITH event ORDER BY event.tick DESC, event.id DESC LIMIT $binding_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(properties(event)) AS boundary_bindings
}
RETURN requested_task_id, task IS NOT NULL AS task_exists, task_resolution,
       properties(task) AS task, goods.goods_id AS goods_id,
       dataset_start, properties(warehouse) AS warehouse_spec,
       properties(source) AS source, properties(target) AS target,
       properties(source_rack) AS source_rack, properties(target_rack) AS target_rack,
       physical_ports, boundary_bindings

queries.name: task_evidence
queries.description: 任务有没有被执行、重新排队或交接？目前有哪些归属和载货证据？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
UNWIND $task_ids AS requested_task_id
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (state:ExecutionState {run_id: $run_id, task_id: requested_task_id})
  WHERE state.tick <= $t
  WITH state ORDER BY state.tick DESC, state.id DESC LIMIT 1
  RETURN properties(state) AS execution_sample
}
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (change:OwnershipChange {run_id: $run_id, task_id: requested_task_id})
  WHERE change.tick <= $t
  WITH change ORDER BY change.tick DESC, change.id DESC LIMIT $evidence_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(properties(change)) AS ownership_changes
}
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (handoff:Handoff {run_id: $run_id, task_id: requested_task_id})
  WHERE handoff.tick <= $t
  WITH handoff ORDER BY handoff.tick DESC, handoff.id DESC LIMIT $evidence_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(properties(handoff)) AS handoffs
}
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id: $run_id, task_id: requested_task_id})
  WHERE event.tick <= $t AND event.type <> 'boundary_port_bound'
  WITH event ORDER BY event.tick DESC, event.id DESC LIMIT $evidence_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(properties(event)) AS operation_events
}
RETURN requested_task_id, (execution_sample IS NOT NULL OR size(ownership_changes) > 0
        OR size(handoffs) > 0 OR size(operation_events) > 0) AS task_observed,
       execution_sample, ownership_changes, handoffs, operation_events

queries.name: peer_states
queries.description: 哪些同伴值得进一步联系或避让？谁可能接走已取下的货？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id: $run_id})
MATCH (robot:Robot {run_id: $run_id})
WHERE robot.robot_id <> $robot_id
CALL {
  WITH robot
  OPTIONAL MATCH (exact:AgentState {id:robot.id+':state:'+toString($t),
                                    run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id, tick:$t})
  CALL {
    WITH robot, exact
    WITH robot WHERE exact IS NULL
    OPTIONAL MATCH (previous:AgentState {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id})
    WHERE previous.tick <= $t
    WITH previous ORDER BY previous.tick DESC, previous.id DESC LIMIT 1
    RETURN head(collect(previous)) AS fallback
  }
  WITH coalesce(exact, fallback) AS state
  RETURN state{.tick, .stage, .battery, .x, .y, .task_id, .cargo_id} AS state
}
RETURN robot.robot_id AS robot_id, robot.type AS robot_type, state,
       $t - state.tick AS age_ticks,
       CASE WHEN state IS NOT NULL AND $t - state.tick <= $max_peer_age_ticks
            THEN true ELSE false END AS state_fresh
ORDER BY robot_id

queries.name: self_feedback
queries.description: 刚才的操作有什么结果？我在等待、耗电还是持续没有进展？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id: $run_id})
MATCH (robot:Robot {id: $run_id + ':robot:' + toString($robot_id), run_id: $run_id})
CALL {
  WITH robot
  MATCH (state:AgentState {run_id: $run_id, robot_node_id: robot.id})
  WHERE $from_tick < state.tick AND state.tick <= $t
  WITH state ORDER BY state.tick DESC, state.id DESC LIMIT $state_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(state{.tick, .stage, .battery, .x, .y, .task_id, .cargo_id}) AS states
}
CALL {
  WITH robot
  MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id: $run_id, robot_node_id: robot.id})
  WHERE $from_tick < event.tick AND event.tick <= $t
  WITH event ORDER BY event.tick DESC, event.id DESC LIMIT $event_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(properties(event)) AS events
}
RETURN robot.robot_id AS robot_id, $from_tick AS from_tick, $t AS through_tick,
       states, events, 'robot_node_id' AS event_scope

queries.name: task_timing
queries.description: 指定任务从分配到取货、完成分别观察到多长时间？是否有重新排队或多轮执行？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
UNWIND $task_ids AS requested_task_id
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WHERE event.tick <= $t
  RETURN count(event) AS observed_event_count,
    sum(CASE WHEN event.type IN ['task_assigned','dataset_task_assigned'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignment_count,
    min(CASE WHEN event.type IN ['task_assigned','dataset_task_assigned'] THEN event.time END) AS assigned_second,
    sum(CASE WHEN event.type IN ['task_picked_up','picked'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pickup_count,
    min(CASE WHEN event.type IN ['task_picked_up','picked'] THEN event.time END) AS picked_second,
    sum(CASE WHEN event.type IN ['task_completed','placed','shipped'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completion_count,
    min(CASE WHEN event.type IN ['task_completed','placed','shipped'] THEN event.time END) AS completed_second,
    sum(CASE WHEN event.type = 'task_requeued' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS requeue_count,
    min(event.tick) AS first_observed_tick, max(event.tick) AS last_observed_tick
}
RETURN requested_task_id, observed_event_count > 0 AS task_observed, observed_event_count,
       assignment_count, assigned_second, pickup_count, picked_second,
       completion_count, completed_second, requeue_count,
       first_observed_tick, last_observed_tick

queries.name: cargo_history
queries.description: 这件货跨任务经历了哪些交接？哪些机器人最近的样本仍显示持有它？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
UNWIND $task_ids AS requested_task_id
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (:Execution {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
                 -[:EXECUTES]->(linked:WarehouseTask {task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH requested_task_id, collect(DISTINCT linked) AS linked_tasks
  OPTIONAL MATCH (scoped:WarehouseTask {dataset_id:$dataset_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH linked_tasks, collect(DISTINCT scoped) AS scoped_tasks
  RETURN CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN linked_tasks[0]
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 0 AND size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN scoped_tasks[0]
              ELSE null END AS task,
         CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_execution_link'
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_execution_links'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_dataset_namespace'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_static_definitions'
              ELSE 'not_observed' END AS task_resolution
}
CALL {
  WITH task
  OPTIONAL MATCH (task)-[:CONCERNS]->(goods:Goods)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (goods)-[:INITIAL_AT]->(location:Location)
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT goods.goods_id) AS static_goods_ids,
         collect(DISTINCT location{.location_id, .kind}) AS initial_locations
}
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (state:ExecutionState {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WHERE state.tick <= $t AND state.cargo_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT state.cargo_id) AS sampled_goods_ids
}
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WHERE event.tick <= $t AND event.cargo_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT event.cargo_id) AS event_goods_ids
}
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (handoff:Handoff {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WHERE handoff.tick <= $t AND handoff.goods_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT handoff.goods_id) AS transferred_goods_ids
}
WITH requested_task_id, initial_locations,
     reduce(ids=[], candidate IN static_goods_ids + sampled_goods_ids + event_goods_ids + transferred_goods_ids |
       CASE WHEN candidate IN ids THEN ids ELSE ids + candidate END) AS goods_ids
WITH requested_task_id, initial_locations, size(goods_ids) AS identity_count,
     CASE WHEN size(goods_ids) = 1 THEN goods_ids[0] ELSE null END AS goods_id
WITH goods_id, CASE WHEN goods_id IS NULL THEN requested_task_id ELSE null END AS unresolved_task_id,
     collect(DISTINCT requested_task_id) AS selected_task_ids,
     max(identity_count) AS cargo_identity_count,
     reduce(locations=[], group IN collect(initial_locations) | locations + group) AS initial_locations
CALL {
  WITH goods_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id:$run_id, cargo_id:goods_id})
  WHERE event.tick <= $t
  WITH event ORDER BY event.tick DESC, event.id DESC LIMIT $event_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(properties(event)) AS cargo_events
}
CALL {
  WITH goods_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (handoff:Handoff {run_id:$run_id, goods_id:goods_id})
  WHERE handoff.tick <= $t
  WITH handoff ORDER BY handoff.tick DESC, handoff.id DESC LIMIT $evidence_fetch_limit
  RETURN collect(properties(handoff)) AS handoffs
}
CALL {
  WITH goods_id
  MATCH (robot:Robot {run_id:$run_id})
  CALL {
    WITH robot
    OPTIONAL MATCH (exact:AgentState {id:robot.id+':state:'+toString($t),
                                    run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id, tick:$t})
  CALL {
    WITH robot, exact
    WITH robot WHERE exact IS NULL
    OPTIONAL MATCH (previous:AgentState {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id})
    WHERE previous.tick <= $t
    WITH previous ORDER BY previous.tick DESC, previous.id DESC LIMIT 1
    RETURN head(collect(previous)) AS fallback
  }
  WITH coalesce(exact, fallback) AS state
    RETURN state
  }
  RETURN count(robot) AS known_robots, count(state) AS robots_with_samples,
    collect(CASE WHEN state.cargo_id = goods_id THEN
      state{.robot_id, .tick, .task_id, .cargo_id, .stage,
            age_ticks:$t-state.tick,
            state_fresh:$t-state.tick <= $max_peer_age_ticks} ELSE null END) AS holder_observations
}
RETURN goods_id, selected_task_ids, cargo_identity_count, initial_locations,
       cargo_events, handoffs, holder_observations, known_robots, robots_with_samples

queries.name: progress_summary
queries.description: 整个观察窗口内有多少状态样本、空间和电量变化？静止判断的采样依据是否足够？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
MATCH (robot:Robot {id:$run_id+':robot:'+toString($robot_id), run_id:$run_id})
CALL {
  WITH robot
  MATCH (state:AgentState {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id})
  WHERE $from_tick < state.tick AND state.tick <= $t
  RETURN count(state) AS sample_count, count(DISTINCT state.tick) AS sampled_tick_count,
    min(state.tick) AS first_sample_tick, max(state.tick) AS last_sample_tick,
    min(state.x) AS min_x, max(state.x) AS max_x,
    min(state.y) AS min_y, max(state.y) AS max_y,
    count(state.x) AS samples_with_x, count(state.y) AS samples_with_y,
    min(state.battery) AS min_soc, max(state.battery) AS max_soc,
    collect(DISTINCT state.stage) AS observed_stages
}
CALL {
  MATCH (step:Step {run_id:$run_id})
  WHERE $from_tick < step.tick AND step.tick <= $t AND step.complete = true
  RETURN count(DISTINCT step.tick) AS observed_complete_ticks
}
RETURN sample_count, sampled_tick_count, first_sample_tick, last_sample_tick,
       min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y, samples_with_x, samples_with_y,
       min_soc, max_soc, observed_stages, observed_complete_ticks

queries.name: completion_feedback
queries.description: 本机最近实际完成了哪些任务？相对任务期限是提前还是延迟？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:$run_id+':robot:'+toString($robot_id)})
WHERE $from_tick < event.tick AND event.tick <= $t
  AND event.type IN ['task_completed','placed','shipped'] AND event.task_id IS NOT NULL
WITH event.task_id AS requested_task_id, min(event.tick) AS completed_tick,
     min(event.time) AS completed_second, count(event) AS completion_event_count
ORDER BY completed_tick DESC, requested_task_id LIMIT $result_fetch_limit
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (:Execution {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
                 -[:EXECUTES]->(linked:WarehouseTask {task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH requested_task_id, collect(DISTINCT linked) AS linked_tasks
  OPTIONAL MATCH (scoped:WarehouseTask {dataset_id:$dataset_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH linked_tasks, collect(DISTINCT scoped) AS scoped_tasks
  RETURN CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN linked_tasks[0]
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 0 AND size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN scoped_tasks[0]
              ELSE null END AS task,
         CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_execution_link'
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_execution_links'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_dataset_namespace'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_static_definitions'
              ELSE 'not_observed' END AS task_resolution
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (dataset:Dataset {id:task.dataset_id})
RETURN requested_task_id AS task_id, task_resolution, completed_tick, completed_second, completion_event_count,
       task IS NOT NULL AS task_exists, task.task_type AS task_type,
       task.due_time AS due_time, dataset.start AS dataset_start
ORDER BY completed_tick DESC, task_id

queries.name: recovery_markers
queries.description: 最近一次停机、解停或电量校正是什么？是否仍缺少晚于停机的恢复证据？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
MATCH (event:RuntimeEvent {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:$run_id+':robot:'+toString($robot_id)})
WHERE event.tick <= $t AND event.type IN [
  'robot_stopped','robot_stop_cleared','robot_reenabled','robot_power_isolated',
  'battery_measurement_corrected','traffic_retimed','task_requeued']
WITH event.type AS kind, max(event.tick) AS latest_tick
MATCH (latest:RuntimeEvent {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:$run_id+':robot:'+toString($robot_id),
                           type:kind, tick:latest_tick})
RETURN properties(latest) AS marker
ORDER BY marker.tick DESC, marker.id DESC LIMIT $result_fetch_limit

queries.name: handoff_outcomes
queries.description: 本机最近参与的接力之后，是否观察到任务继续执行或完成？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
MATCH (handoff:Handoff {run_id:$run_id})
WHERE $from_tick < handoff.tick AND handoff.tick <= $t
  AND (handoff.donor_id = $robot_id OR handoff.receiver_id = $robot_id)
WITH handoff ORDER BY handoff.tick DESC, handoff.id DESC LIMIT $result_fetch_limit
CALL {
  WITH handoff
  OPTIONAL MATCH (state:ExecutionState {run_id:$run_id, task_id:handoff.task_id})
  WHERE handoff.tick < state.tick AND state.tick <= $t
  WITH state ORDER BY state.tick DESC, state.id DESC LIMIT 1
  RETURN properties(state) AS post_transfer_sample
}
CALL {
  WITH handoff
  OPTIONAL MATCH (done:ExecutionState {run_id:$run_id, task_id:handoff.task_id, status:'completed'})
  WHERE handoff.tick < done.tick AND done.tick <= $t
  WITH done ORDER BY done.tick, done.id LIMIT 1
  RETURN done.tick AS completion_tick
}
RETURN properties(handoff) AS handoff,
  CASE WHEN handoff.donor_id = $robot_id THEN 'donor' ELSE 'receiver' END AS my_role,
  post_transfer_sample, completion_tick,
  CASE WHEN completion_tick IS NOT NULL THEN completion_tick-handoff.tick ELSE null END AS observed_completion_latency_ticks
ORDER BY handoff.tick DESC, handoff.id DESC

queries.name: rack_workload
queries.description: 哪些货架被已观察的机器人主任务同时引用？选任务时有哪些作业集中区域？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
MATCH (robot:Robot {run_id:$run_id})
CALL {
  WITH robot
  OPTIONAL MATCH (exact:AgentState {id:robot.id+':state:'+toString($t),
                                    run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id, tick:$t})
  CALL {
    WITH robot, exact
    WITH robot WHERE exact IS NULL
    OPTIONAL MATCH (previous:AgentState {run_id:$run_id, robot_node_id:robot.id})
    WHERE previous.tick <= $t
    WITH previous ORDER BY previous.tick DESC, previous.id DESC LIMIT 1
    RETURN head(collect(previous)) AS fallback
  }
  WITH coalesce(exact, fallback) AS state
  RETURN state
}
WITH robot, state, state.task_id AS requested_task_id WHERE state.task_id IS NOT NULL
CALL {
  WITH requested_task_id
  OPTIONAL MATCH (:Execution {run_id:$run_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
                 -[:EXECUTES]->(linked:WarehouseTask {task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH requested_task_id, collect(DISTINCT linked) AS linked_tasks
  OPTIONAL MATCH (scoped:WarehouseTask {dataset_id:$dataset_id, task_id:requested_task_id})
  WITH linked_tasks, collect(DISTINCT scoped) AS scoped_tasks
  RETURN CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN linked_tasks[0]
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 0 AND size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN scoped_tasks[0]
              ELSE null END AS task,
         CASE WHEN size(linked_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_execution_link'
              WHEN size(linked_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_execution_links'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) = 1 THEN 'run_dataset_namespace'
              WHEN size(scoped_tasks) > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_static_definitions'
              ELSE 'not_observed' END AS task_resolution
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (task)-[:FROM|TO]->(location:Location)
WHERE location.kind = 'slot'
WITH robot, state, requested_task_id, task, task_resolution, location
WHERE location IS NOT NULL OR task IS NULL
RETURN location.rack_id AS rack_id,
  collect(DISTINCT robot.robot_id) AS observed_robot_ids,
  collect(DISTINCT requested_task_id) AS observed_task_ids,
  collect(DISTINCT task_resolution) AS task_resolutions,
  collect(DISTINCT location.level) AS referenced_slot_levels,
  count(DISTINCT robot.robot_id) AS observed_robot_count,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN $t-state.tick <= $max_peer_age_ticks THEN robot.robot_id ELSE null END) AS fresh_reference_count,
  min(state.tick) AS oldest_state_tick, max(state.tick) AS newest_state_tick
ORDER BY fresh_reference_count DESC, observed_robot_count DESC, rack_id
LIMIT $result_fetch_limit

queries.name: port_pressure_history
queries.description: 已记录的出入库工位件数在最近快照中上升还是下降？是否需要重新评估工位选择？
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:Run {id:$run_id})
MATCH (snapshot:DispatchState {run_id:$run_id})
WHERE $from_tick < snapshot.tick AND snapshot.tick <= $t
RETURN snapshot.tick AS observed_tick, snapshot.commit_seq AS commit_seq,
       snapshot.elapsed AS elapsed, snapshot.ports_json AS ports_json
ORDER BY observed_tick DESC, commit_seq DESC LIMIT $result_fetch_limit
